evidence: mobile-native/shared/src/commonMain/kotlin/three/two/bit/ppt/reality/auth/SsoService.kt — 12 public methods (createMobileToken, validateAndLogin, loginWithPassword, register, requestPasswordReset, confirmPasswordReset, getSession, refreshSession, updateProfile, restoreSession, logout, isAuthenticated) carry the mobile auth-state machine
grep for 'SsoService' under mobile-native/shared/src/commonTest returns 0 files — only SsoInitiationTest (nonce) and SsoStateStoreTest (CSRF store) exist; neither exercises SsoService

untested auth-critical behaviour includes the 401->logout() branch in getSession()/refreshSession() and the authState transitions in validateAndLogin()/loginWithPassword()/restoreSession() — a regression here silently breaks re-auth with no test to catch it
